item.text:
**3B.2 Research Note**

Overall read: mixed. Lula’s federal government did take some concrete anti-abuse steps in 2024, especially on police use of force and accountability for coup-linked military/police actors, but the record still shows persistent police killings, prison overcrowding, and torture/ill-treatment with incomplete compliance on independent-investigation reforms.

- [Portaria MJSP nº 648, de 28 de maio de 2024](http://dspace.mj.gov.br/handle/1/12967) — Ministério da Justiça e Segurança Pública — 2024-05-28  
  - Claim-level summary: established national guidelines for body cameras in public security agencies, aiming at standardized audiovisual recording, transparency, evidence preservation, and better control of police conduct.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.2; also 3B.1

- [Relatório do MJSP apresenta diagnóstico sobre o uso de câmeras corporais policiais](https://www.gov.br/mj/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/relatorio-do-mjsp-apresenta-diagnostico-sobre-o-uso-de-cameras-corporais-policiais) — Ministério da Justiça e Segurança Pública — 2024-07-31  
  - Claim-level summary: the ministry’s review summarized studies linking body cameras to lower police lethality and more reporting, which is direct policy evidence of an anti-abuse approach.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.2; also 3B.1

- [Decreto que atualiza regras sobre o uso diferenciado da força pelas polícias é publicado](https://www.gov.br/mj/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/decreto-que-atualiza-regras-sobre-o-uso-diferenciado-da-forca-pelas-policias-e-publicado) — Ministério da Justiça e Segurança Pública — 2024-12-24  
  - Claim-level summary: Lula signed a decree updating police-use-of-force rules and less-lethal instruments, explicitly framing the reform around efficiency, professionalization, and respect for human rights.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.2

- [Brazil marks anniversary of Jan. 8 attack on democracy](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/brazil-to-mark-anniversary-of-january-8-attack-on-democracy-3269163) — Reuters via Investing.com — 2024-01-08  
  - Claim-level summary: Lula said those who financed, planned, and executed the coup attempt should be “exemplarily punished,” showing public support for punishing anti-democratic illegal conduct rather than tolerating it.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.2; also 3B.1, 2B.9

- [PF prende militares e policial suspeitos de planejar golpe de Estado em 2022 com morte de Lula](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/11/19/pf-desarticula-organizacao-que-planejou-golpe-de-estado-com-planos-de-assassinar-lula-e-alckmin.htm) — Reuters via UOL — 2024-11-19  
  - Claim-level summary: federal police arrested four military personnel and a federal police officer over an alleged plan to kill Lula and stage a coup; this is evidence of state accountability reaching into military/police ranks rather than shielding them.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.2; also 3B.1, 2B.9

- [Brazil: Comply with Rulings on Police Violence](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/03/15/brazil-comply-rulings-police-violence) — Human Rights Watch — 2024-03-15  
  - Claim-level summary: HRW said Brazil still had not fully complied with Inter-American Court rulings requiring independent investigations of police killings and other abuses; police abuse remained acute, including lethal raids in Baixada Santista.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.2

- [World Report 2025: Brazil](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2025/country-chapters/brazil) — Human Rights Watch — 2025 (covering events of 2024)  
  - Claim-level summary: police abuse continued in 2024, with 4,565 police killings by September, very limited charging in Baixada Santista killings, and prison conditions marked by overcrowding, unhealthy conditions, and ill-treatment/torture in at least six states.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.2

Search gap: I did not find reliable 2024 evidence of a Lula-led overhaul of intelligence services, a targeted anti-militia/vigilante campaign, or a prison anti-torture crackdown beyond the broader police-force reforms and the prosecution of coup-linked military/police actors. That gap keeps the overall assessment mixed rather than a clear pass.
